text.description_html:
Laurey 39528, Rustic Midtown Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull

The Satin Nickel Midtown Cabinet Pull has a unique style that is well-suited to rustic and tuscan home decor designs, the Midtown Cabinet Pull in Satin Nickel is sure to represent your style. The Midtown Cabinet Pull has a 3 inch center to center and is 4 inches overall. The Rustic Midtown Satin Nickel Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Midtown Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39528 3 Inch Satin Nickel Midtown Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Satin Nickel
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

Available finishes:
Satin Nickel Matte Black / Terra Cotta Wash

Sold Individually
